description: This file defines a React component for a User Management page in a multi-tenant accounting front-end application. It handles displaying a list of users, creating new users via a form, and fetching data from an API. The component uses hooks like useState, useEffect, and useCallback, and utilizes imported UI components.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronous callback to fetch the list of users from the API and update the state.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Handles form submission to create a new user via API and refresh the user list.
